title: Higher education program research & comparison
description: Research and compare candidate colleges or universities against a student's fit, cost, and admissions odds, then score the shortlist against the family's priorities.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: higher-ed-research
  title: Higher education program research & comparison
  description: Research and compare candidate colleges or universities against a student's fit, cost, and admissions odds, then score the shortlist against the family's priorities.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a well-researched, priority-scored shortlist of colleges or universities for a student.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: student-profile
      kind: input
      name: Student profile and priorities
      summary: The student's academic profile, budget, priorities, and candidate schools.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The student's academic profile, budget, priorities, and target list of colleges or universities." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: program-fit-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Academic program fit analyst
      summary: Assesses how well each school's programs match the student's interests.
      role: Higher-education program-fit researcher
      prompt: Research how well each candidate school's academic programs, majors, and campus environment match the student's stated interests and priorities. Note strengths, gaps, and any programs that stand out for the student's intended major. Describe what to look up on each school's official site rather than asserting specific facts you have not verified. This is informational research only, not professional college-admissions counseling, and the family should confirm details with the schools and a licensed counselor if needed.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: cost-roi-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Cost and ROI analyst
      summary: Estimates the general cost and return-on-investment picture for each school.
      role: Higher-education cost and return-on-investment researcher
      prompt: Estimate the general cost picture and likely return on investment for each candidate school based on published tuition, aid, and outcomes data the family should verify directly. Describe what published data to check, such as net price calculators and outcomes reports, rather than inventing dollar figures. This is not financial advice, and the family should confirm actual costs and aid with each school's financial aid office before deciding.
      capabilities: { skills: [finance-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: admissions-odds-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Admissions odds analyst
      summary: Assesses how competitive admissions are relative to the student's profile.
      role: Admissions likelihood researcher
      prompt: Assess how competitive each candidate school's admissions are relative to the student's academic profile, using published acceptance-rate and typical-admit-profile data as a guide. Categorize each school as a reach, match, or likely option and explain the reasoning. Note that admissions outcomes are inherently uncertain and this analysis is not a guarantee of any result.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: parallel-research-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel school research
      summary: Runs the fit, cost, and admissions analysts side by side.
      config: { members: [program-fit-analyst, cost-roi-analyst, admissions-odds-analyst], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: merge-findings
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge research findings
      summary: Combines the three analyst outputs into one research packet.
      config: { aggregation: merge }
    - id: score-against-priorities
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score against student priorities
      summary: Scores the merged research against the student's stated priorities.
      role: Independent priorities-fit evaluator
      prompt: Score the merged research against the student's stated priorities from the intake brief. Return a numeric score, a pass/fail on whether the shortlist is ready, and clear reasons for the score. This is advisory research support, not a guarantee of any admissions or financial outcome.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.75 }
    - id: shortlist-ready
      kind: condition
      name: Shortlist ready?
      summary: Branches on whether the shortlist meets the priorities bar.
      config: { expression: "score-against-priorities.passed", branches: [ { label: Ready, when: "true" }, { label: NeedsMoreResearch, when: "false" } ] }
    - id: expand-research
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Expand research on weak spots
      summary: Identifies gaps and suggests follow-up research.
      role: Follow-up research specialist
      prompt: Identify the specific gaps the evaluator flagged and describe additional research the family should do to close them, such as campus visits, additional program pages, or advisor conversations. Do not fabricate specifics; point to sources the family should check.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: shortlist-output
      kind: output
      name: College shortlist and research summary
      summary: The final shortlist with supporting research and scores.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: student-profile, to: parallel-research-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: parallel-research-group, to: merge-findings, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: merge-findings, to: score-against-priorities, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: score-against-priorities, to: shortlist-ready, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: shortlist-ready, to: shortlist-output, kind: control, condition: "true" }
    - { id: e6, from: shortlist-ready, to: expand-research, kind: control, condition: "false" }
    - { id: e7, from: expand-research, to: shortlist-output, kind: data }
